race.comment: NEED A MIRACLE (2) finished second last start over 1400m at this track when he made late ground, beaten only a nose. Should be peaking now and gets 3kg off with the claim. Placed to advantage and can run a bold race. FAMAHAN (6) has two placings from four starts this preparation and last start finished a head from the winner in second over 1600m at this venue. Useful type who gets his chance. BLAZED PRINCE (5) gets the services of in-form Bullock in the irons and only needs some luck from the wide draw to be featuring in the finish. ZOU BIG BOY (1) is a last-start winner who gets 3kg off from the low draw. Has to be included in calculations.
